name: live-uml
description: Live PlantUML flowchart, sequence diagram, state machine and class diagram for C, C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python code

liveUml.javaPath.description: Path to the Java executable used to run PlantUML. Set this if Java is not in your system PATH, or to use a specific Java installation.

liveUml.classExcludePatterns.description: Comma-separated directory names to exclude from class diagram scanning.

liveUml.debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to the 'Live UML' output channel. Useful for diagnosing blank sidebar or diagram generation issues.

liveUml.llm.enabled.description: Show an LLM-written summary of the selected function above the diagram.

enumDescriptions: Update after function edits (1.2-second debounce); reuse unchanged summaries.
Only request a summary when Generate/Regenerate summary is pressed.
liveUml.llm.updateMode.description: When to generate AI summaries. The Regenerate summary button always requests a fresh summary.

liveUml.llm.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Use http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 for LM Studio, http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 for Ollama.

liveUml.llm.model.description: Model name sent to the endpoint.

liveUml.llm.apiKey.description: Legacy settings-based API key. Prefer entering the key in the Live UML sidebar gear panel, which uses VS Code secret storage. Environment fallback: LIVEUML_LLM_KEY or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

liveUml.llm.timeoutMs.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for slow local models.
